A mysterious girl who appeared before Fuminori, sparking intrigue with her quest to find her missing father. In Fuminori's distorted perception, Saya is the only figure of normalcy and becomes a crucial source of mental support. As time passes, she gradually grows fond of Fuminori, reciprocating his deep affection and care towards her.
True to Fuminori's suspicion, Saya is not a human; she's an eldritch entity whose actual form is perceived as grotesque and horrifying to everyone except Fuminori.

Her origins are ambiguous and subject to various interpretations throughout the story. The narrative suggests that she is not of this world, either literally or metaphorically. She has no memories of where she came from and is guided only by her instincts. Her relationship with Fuminori strongly influences her behavior, and she takes actions driven by her desire to be with him and understand his world.

Saya usually hides in the shadows and preys on creatures of all sizes, from cats to human beings, typically killing them by snapping their necks or disembowelment through some unknown means and then feasting on their internal organs.
Based on Wikipedia and in-game content

In Kishin Hishou, after the failure of Infinite Spiral, she managed a different scheme that involved with the son of Elder Gods. This time she is acting as the Game Keeper set up Game of Chaos across space and time for Daijuuji Kuzaku, with his opponent is Another Blood. Super Sonico was created by the Nitroplus Company in 2007 to be the mascot for their yearly Nitro Super Sonic (NSS) Music Festival held in Japan each year. Since her creation, she has become quite popular and has even starred in her own video game: SoniComi, the PS3/PSV game Motto! SoniComi and the 3DS idol producing game SoniPro. She even starred in her own anime, SoniAni.
She also a member of band Dai Ichi Uchuu Sokudo and has released several singles and albums.
From 2011.03.01 till 2011.05.31 Sonico starred in Kimisho as a limited time heroine.
